deviations_from_preregistration.why: Taldau publishes quarterly births by region only from January-March 2014
deviations_from_preregistration.pre_registered_result: not estimable: no quarterly regional births before 2014

deviations_from_preregistration.what: Marriage rate enters as the last published annual year-on-year change (lag 1 quarter after publication) instead of the quarterly change lagged 3 quarters
deviations_from_preregistration.why: Taldau gives registered marriages by region only annually

deviations_from_preregistration.what: Real wage replaced by real per-capita money income (annual, deflated by the regional CPI annual average)
deviations_from_preregistration.why: no quarterly regional wage series was downloaded; per-capita income is the closest regional income measure obtained

deviations_from_preregistration.what: Housing commissioned replaced by housing per resident (m2, annual)
deviations_from_preregistration.why: the housing-commissioned series was not obtained; the housing-stock series measures the same space constraint, more slowly

deviations_from_preregistration.what: Population after January 2024 projected at each region's growth over the previous 12 months
deviations_from_preregistration.why: the downloaded population file ends at 1 January 2024
deviations_from_preregistration.pre_registered_result: the pre-registration assumed published population for every quarter

deviations_from_preregistration.why: 2015Q3 falls before the first estimation quarter (2016Q1); 2018Q2 is the South Kazakhstan / Shymkent split

forecast.note: Sum of the 16 regional forecasts; population held at its latest quarterly value; contributions are birth-weighted averages of the regional ones.
